title: Move ward-cli to the lore/quest 0.14.1 pair: regenerate the managed Quest block, regenerate lore artifacts, bump the CI lore pin
description:
Found by the Sunday estate audit on 2026-10-25 at about 06:32Z (01:32 local), CORRECTED from an earlier version of this record that said 2026-10-24, and approved by opum-doc as an owner task, tracked fleet-wide as OPAG-1521. Filed tracker-only on 2026-10-25; the fix waited for the day plan, which scheduled it the same day.

MEASURED on origin/dev 64f9f02 (2026-10-25): the CLAUDE.md managed Quest block declares `Quest CLI 0.13.0`, and .github/workflows/ci.yml:70 pins `LORE_VERSION: 0.13.0`. npm publishes @opum-ai/lore 0.14.1 and @opum-ai/quest 0.14.1, and the workstation globals are 0.14.1 for both.

WHY BOTH PINS MUST MOVE: the Quest pin lives only in the managed block -- the Tracker CI job sed-reads `Quest CLI <version>` out of CLAUDE.md and installs that version -- so regenerating the block IS the Quest pin bump. The lore pin is the explicit LORE_VERSION constant in ci.yml.

SCOPE: routine managed-block regeneration (`quest agents --update-instructions --target claude`) plus the pin bump, the same shape as WCLI-71 (0.12.0 to 0.13.0). Generated bytes only, no hand edits inside or around the managed markers, and the carve-out means no operator ask is needed for them. Schema regeneration under 0.14.1 belongs here too: local `lore check` exited 6 with schema-drift on all 11 schemas before this change, which is the 0.14.1 export differing from the 0.13.0 export. Out of scope: the docs frontmatter lore/X.Y.Z provenance stamps, which are history rather than live pins.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ci.yml LORE_VERSION reads 0.14.1, and no live CI pin of @opum-ai/lore or LORE_VERSION still reads 0.13.0
The CLAUDE.md managed Quest block declares Quest CLI 0.14.1, every changed byte in it sits between the managed markers, and quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exits 0
lore agents --check exits 0 under lore 0.14.1, and lore check --strict and lore validate --strict are green
The PR head SHA is green in Check, Docs and Tracker integrity, with the Docs job installing lore 0.14.1 and the Tracker job installing Quest 0.14.1 read from the log version line

implementationNotes: Landed in opum-ai/ward-cli#168 on commit 4851911bfad99c30767190993c991c9432b239df, validated by CI run 40195908929: Check, Docs and Tracker integrity all completed success on that head. Docs job log carries LORE_VERSION: 0.14.1 on every step, including the install step, and its install equality guard passed (added 2 packages). Tracker job log carries "Declared Quest version: 0.14.1" and QUEST_VERSION: 0.14.1, with its equality guard passing (added 17 packages). Local gates at lore/quest 0.14.1 on the same tree: lore check --strict exit 0 (32 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 4 profiles read 0 over capacity), lore validate --strict exit 0 (32 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 4 skipped), quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exit 0, lore agents --check exit 0, node scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs exit 0 (28 concepts, 4 profiles, 0 in no profile), bun run check exit 0 (772 pass / 0 fail), git diff --check clean. Schema drift is gone: lore check exited 6 with schema-drift on all 11 schemas before the lore schema export under 0.14.1, and 0 after. lore agents --check still reports absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md and the disabled plugin -- unchanged by this task and scoped to WCLI-79, which lands next. Field-name sweep for @opum-ai/lore, @opum-ai/quest and LORE_VERSION found no live 0.13.0 pin outside .claude/worktrees/review-149-408161b, which is a DEC-208 review worktree at an old SHA and is not touched.
finalSummary: Move ward-cli to the lore/quest 0.14.1 pair, delivered in opum-ai/ward-cli#168. Three generated changes and no hand edits: the managed Quest block regenerated 0.13.0 -> 0.14.1 by quest agents --update-instructions --target claude (one line inside the markers; the Tracker job derives its install from it, so the block is the Quest pin); .lore/schemas/ exported under lore 0.14.1, which adds decisions to the ADR schema and bumps every profileDigest and clears the schema-drift that made lore check exit 6 on all 11 schemas; and ci.yml LORE_VERSION 0.13.0 -> 0.14.1. The record audit date was also corrected to 2026-10-25 ~06:32Z in the same commit, per the orchestrator ruling. Verified on commit 4851911bfad99c30767190993c991c9432b239df by CI run 40195908929, green in Check, Docs and Tracker integrity, with the Docs job logged at LORE_VERSION 0.14.1 and the Tracker job logging Declared Quest version: 0.14.1. Local gates at 0.14.1: lore check --strict 0, lore validate --strict 0, quest agents --check 0, lore agents --check 0, check-lore-agent-sources 0, bun run check 0 (772 pass), git diff --check clean.
